title: Loading spinners for slow operations
description:
Goal: nothing that can take more than a moment should look frozen (avoid reflexive ctrl+c).

Plan (~half day):
- Add indicatif; one helper in src/ui.rs, e.g. let _s = ui::spinner("scanning sources…"); RAII guard that clears on drop.
- Only draw when stderr is a TTY and color/term allow it (respect ui::color_supported / NO_COLOR / TERM=dumb); only appear after ~250ms so fast ops don't flicker.
- Route println/eprintln during a spinner through ProgressBar::suspend (or println on the bar) to avoid garbled lines.
- Never active while the AI backend owns the terminal (run_interactive in backend.rs).

Call sites: ManifestLock wait (see lock-wait issue), workspace assembly in process, teardown/merge, pdftotext/pandoc in slides.rs, reconcile scan (rarely slow, but cheap to wrap).

Tests: helper is a no-op when not a TTY (CI output unchanged).
